sources.prompt: Create ONE NEW realistic strawberry cutout for a florist bouquet, using the attached bouquet photo solely to understand real fruit shape and subtle surface detail. Do not reproduce the photo, text, wrapping, branding or multiple fruit. Match the reference's actual strawberries, NOT shiny supermarket clipart. This berry stands upright with its leafy base concealed below and a short, rounded tapered end above; camera looking down at it from a high oblique angle. The visible outline is compact plump oval with gently narrower upper third, about 1.18 height to width, not a triangular heart or a ball with a nipple. The top tip and side are a continuous softly curved body. Deep ripe burgundy-crimson red, matte natural skin, hundreds of TINY subdued reddish-gold seed specks (each less than 1 percent of berry width), extremely shallow dimples. No large yellow seeds, no deep holes, no exaggerated surface texture, no wet white shine or bright hard highlights. Soft overcast daylight, neutral shadows gently on lower right. Photographic fruit at ordinary viewing distance, not a macro advertisement or 3D render. Isolate the WHOLE single berry on genuine alpha transparency, no exterior shadow, no greens, no skewer. Square image with fruit taking 85 percent height. Its pointed end leans very slightly left.
